definition_zh: 建立一种特殊的组织形式——生产建设兵团，既是军事单位又是生产单位，实现国防建设与经济发展的有机统一。
definition_en: Establish a special organizational form - Production and Construction Corps, which is both a military unit and a production unit, achieving organic unity of national defense construction and economic development.
process_zh: 明确兵团的双重职能定位
建立军事化的组织架构
实施农业现代化的生产技术
形成自我循环的经济体系
实现社会稳定与国家安全的统一
process_en: Clarify the dual function positioning of the corps
Achieve unity of social stability and national security
application_zh: 大型国有企业改革、军民融合产业发展、边疆区域治理
application_en: Large state-owned enterprise reform, military-civilian integration industry development, border regional governance
modern_parallel_zh: 现代企业集团治理、军民融合创新
thinking_skill_zh: 制度设计、组织创新、系统思维
key_quote_en: Integration of party, government, military and enterprise
